sentences.en: There are twelve months in a year.
One hundred is a round number.
There are seven days in a week.
A month has about thirty days.
The clock on the wall says three o'clock.
A minute is a short time.
The clock gives us the time.
The past year was a good one.
sentences.zh: 过去的一年是美好的一年。

sentences.en: We have no memory of the future.
I have a watch on my arm.
sentences.zh: 我手臂上戴着一块手表。
